You are implementing Task 2: the guard arm in `transition`.

## Task Description
Read your task brief first — it is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-2-brief.md

Also read the global constraints (they bind every task):
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/global-constraints.md

## Context
SMA-864: the agent loop runs tool calls from a model turn that ended with `FinishReason::Length` (a cut turn) or `ContentFilter`. The pure state machine `transition(state, input, ctx)` in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/loop_state.rs` is called by both the local driver (agent.rs) and the Temporal driver; putting the guard there covers both. The whole turn is treated as one unit: if any ToolCall is present (including a handoff/transfer call), none runs and the run fails.

Task 1 (commit f2b252cc) already added, in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/agent.rs`:
`AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Option<FinishReason>, tool_names: Vec<String> }` (variant is `#[non_exhaustive]`, so construct it inside the crate normally; in the external test file `tests/transition_unit.rs`, match it with `..`). Its Display text is already done; the RunFailed event carries `error: err.to_string()`.

Rulings for ambiguity: the guard arm must sit after the max-turns arm and before the existing "Model produced tool calls" arm, so that a max-turns condition still wins as today. Emit `MessageOutput` events for assistant message items in item order, using the same construction the existing Done/text path uses — look at how the neighboring arms build `MessageOutput` and `RunFailed` and follow that pattern exactly. `conversation_appends` must be empty.

## Before You Begin
If anything in the brief is unclear, ask now.

## Your Job
1. Write the 7 failing tests (TDD), run to confirm tests 1-4 fail and 5-7 pass.
2. Implement the arm. 3. Verify. 4. `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. 5. Commit (stage by explicit path). 6. Self-review. 7. Report.

Work from: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864 (use absolute paths; `cd` with `|| exit 1`).

Safety: never run git checkout, switch, reset, rebase, stash, or anything that moves HEAD or a branch. Do not push. Do not dispatch subagents of any kind. Run every cargo command in the foreground and wait for it to end; do not end your turn until every command has finished. If the commit fails with a 1Password error, stop and report BLOCKED; never bypass signing.

Known pre-existing issue: `tests/trybuild_ui.rs` in core fails locally on rustc 1.99 diagnostic text; it fails without any change too. Ignore it, mention it in the report, do not re-bless.

While iterating, run the focused test; run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core` once before committing.

## Self-Review
Completeness, quality, YAGNI, existing patterns, pristine test output. Fix issues before reporting.

## Report Format
Write your full report to:
/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864/.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-27-sma-864-no-tool-calls-after-length/task-2-report.md
Include: what you implemented, tests and results, TDD evidence (RED command + failing output and why expected; GREEN command + passing output), files changed, self-review findings, concerns.

Then reply with ONLY (under 15 lines): Status (DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT), commits (short SHA + subject), one-line test summary, concerns, report file path.

<system-reminder>
Your final report is delivered through SubagentHandback: when your work is complete, call SubagentHandback({message: <your full report>}). The call ends your run, so make it your last step. Only a SubagentHandback call reaches your caller as your result; plain text you write at the end is not delivered. Do not also send the report with SendMessage: your caller would get it twice.
</system-reminder>

### Task 2: The guard arm in `transition`

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/loop_state.rs` (a new arm after the max-turns arm and before the "Model produced tool calls" arm, ~line 286)
- Test: `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/tests/transition_unit.rs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun` (Task 1).
- Produces: `transition(CallingModel, ModelResponse { finish_reason: Length | ContentFilter, items with ≥1 ToolCall })` → `next_state: LoopState::Failed(AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Some(r), tool_names })`, `next_action: NextAction::Terminate`, `conversation_appends: []`, events = `MessageOutput` per assistant item (item order), then `RunFailed { error: err.to_string() }`. No `ToolCallItem`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests** (use `ctx_with` and `assert_matches!` from the file; build a `TransitionCtx` with `handoffs: &[HandoffDef]` for test 4 as the existing handoff tests at ~line 652 do):
  1. `length_with_one_tool_call_fails_without_running_it` — the acceptance-criteria test. Assert the state matches `LoopState::Failed(AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Some(FinishReason::Length), ref tool_names, .. })` with `tool_names == ["search"]`; `NextAction::Terminate`; the last event is `RunFailed`; no event is `ToolCallItem`.
  2. `content_filter_with_one_tool_call_fails_without_running_it` — the same with `ContentFilter`.
  3. `length_with_three_tool_calls_runs_none` — calls with `call_id` `"a"`, `"b"`, `"c"` and names `"x"`, `"y"`, `"z"` → `tool_names == ["x","y","z"]`.
  4. `length_with_text_and_handoff_fails_without_handoff` — assistant text + a transfer call whose name matches a `HandoffDef` → state is `Failed`, not `ApplyingHandoff`; events are `[MessageOutput, RunFailed]` in that order.
  5. `length_without_tool_calls_still_completes` — text only + `Length` → `LoopState::Done`.
  6. `stop_with_tool_call_still_executes` — `Stop` + one call → `LoopState::ExecutingTools`.
  7. `other_function_call_with_tool_call_still_executes` — `FinishReason::Other("function_call".into())` + one call → `LoopState::ExecutingTools`.
- [ ] **Step 2:** Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core --test transition_unit` → tests 1-4 FAIL, tests 5-7 PASS.
- [ ] **Step 3:** Add the guard arm. Match `TransitionInput::ModelResponse { items, finish_reason: r @ (FinishReason::Length | FinishReason::ContentFilter), .. }` with a guard `items.iter().any(|i| matches!(i, Item::ToolCall { .. }))`. Collect `tool_names` from `Item::ToolCall { name, .. }` in item order.
- [ ] **Step 4:** Run the same command → all PASS. Run `cargo test -p paigasus-helikon-core` → PASS.
- [ ] **Step 5:** Commit `fix(core): SMA-864 do not run tool calls from a length or content-filter turn`.

## Global Constraints

- Work only in the worktree `/Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864`. Use worktree-absolute paths. Do not run `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git reset`, `git rebase` or any command that moves HEAD or another branch.
- Run every cargo command in the foreground and wait for it to end. Do not background it.
- Commit messages: `<type>(<scope>): SMA-864 <lowercase subject>`. Allowed scopes here: `core`, `runtime-temporal`, `providers`, `providers-anthropic`, `providers-openai`, `docs`, `specs`, `plan`. There is no `providers-bedrock`/`providers-litellm`/`providers-gemini` scope; use `providers`.
- End each commit message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- Stage files by explicit path. Never `git add -A` or `git add .` (`.env` and `.claude/` are not ignored).
- Before each commit: `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` must be clean.
- Every new public item gets a `///` doc comment (`missing_docs`, `-D warnings` docs gate). A public doc comment must not intra-doc-link a private item.
- Error variant name and shape (exact): `AgentError::ToolCallsNotRun { finish_reason: Option<FinishReason>, tool_names: Vec<String> }`, with `#[non_exhaustive]` on the variant.
- Blocked finish reasons (exact): `FinishReason::Length` and `FinishReason::ContentFilter`. All other reasons, including `Stop` and `Other(_)`, keep today's behavior.
- Name cap in the `Display` text: the same rule as `format_blank_names` in `crates/paigasus-helikon-core/src/model.rs` (8 names, 64 characters each).

- Do not dispatch subagents. Do not push. Work synchronously and in the foreground; do not end your turn until every command you started has finished.
- Commits are signed with a 1Password SSH key. If a commit fails with "failed to fill whole buffer", stop and report BLOCKED (the vault is locked); never bypass signing.
